meta.name: xdrop
meta.description: Use this skill when the user wants to send or fetch files through an Xdrop server from the terminal, asks to automate encrypted Xdrop share-link workflows, provides an Xdrop `/t/:transferId#k=...` link to download and decrypt locally, or needs Xdrop CLI flags such as `--quiet`, `--json`, `--expires-in`, `--output`, or `--api-url`, even if they do not explicitly mention the skill name.

copy.tagline: 通过终端安全地发送和接收文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在命令行中快速安全地传输文件
copy.tagline_en: Send and receive files securely via terminal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly and securely transfer files from the command line

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你通过终端上传文件到 Xdrop 服务器并生成分享链接，或者下载并解密 Xdrop 分享链接中的文件。
howto.when: 当你需要从终端上传或下载文件到 Xdrop 服务器，或者你提供了一个 Xdrop 分享链接（包含 #k=... 密钥）时触发。

say.text: 帮我上传这个 report.pdf 到 Xdrop 服务器。
say.note: Claude 会执行上传脚本并返回分享链接。

say.text: 用安静模式上传 archive.zip，过期时间设为 600 秒。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you upload files to an Xdrop server via terminal and generate a share link, or download and decrypt files from an Xdrop share link.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to upload or download files to/from an Xdrop server via terminal, or when you provide an Xdrop share link (including the #k=... fragment).

say_en.text: Upload this report.pdf to the Xdrop server.
say_en.note: Claude will run the upload script and return a share link.

say_en.text: Download files from this Xdrop link: http://localhost:8080/t/abc123#k=...
say_en.note: Claude will download and decrypt the files locally.

say_en.text: Upload archive.zip quietly with an expiry of 600 seconds.
